summary: Gameweek 6 score_xp and forecast_xp were run on xmi_t1.csv and betfair_t1. plan_half names the wildcard in Gameweek 6 because the rebuild leads the untouched squad by 19.68 over the two priced weeks. The same rebuild leads the one-transfer path, van Ewijk to Silva, by 15.09, which is under 16. The 138.80 value is Gameweek 6 and 7 only, including the Gameweek 7 rebuilt bench. Gameweek 8 is an outright forecast. Gameweek 9 repeats it. No slot_t1.json, so this is not the ep_next decision. Haaland is 4.59 on 45 minutes and is benched on the wildcard.
